Welcome to First Derm, your trusted Online Dermatologist! We offer fast, accurate, and anonymous consultations for all your skin concerns. With First Derm, you can say goodbye to the hassle of traditional in-person dermatology appointments. 

With over 100,000 successfully reviewed cases, our app is backed by board-certified dermatologists with years of training and experience. 

First Derm quickly connects you to a Dermatologist, who can let you know whether that Spot or Rash is something you should actually be concerned about. 

Simply take a picture of your skin, fill out the form, and send it to our team of board-certified dermatologists. Your information will always be kept anonymous and secured. A dermatologist will get back to you with the likely condition and instructions on what to do next. 
Our consultation starts at $29.95 (€25/ £20)

Getting started is simple:
1. Download the free app: No registration needed, you're anonymous!
2. Take two clear photos of the affected area and fill out a short medical intake form.
3. Pay the case fee based on your desired response time.(8 hrs, 24 hrs, or 48 hrs)
4. Save your unique 8-digit case number and use it to read your results.

On average over 70% of cases submitted to First Derm can be treated with over-the-counter medication, potentially saving you an unnecessary visit to the doctor. 

For more serious cases, our dermatologists may recommend a face-to-face consultation with a local dermatologist, which could potentially fast-track your visit.

First Derm - Online dermatology app also has features to locate a dermatologist, pediatrician, or pharmacy near you. Plus, with an answer from First Derm, our users see a dermatologist two weeks faster than the US average of 32 days.

Our service is globally accessible, with our team offering services in seven languages and reaching over 160 countries worldwide.

- Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
- Contact Dermatitis
- Folliculitis (ingrown hair)

- Skin rash

- Oral herpes, Genital herpes

- Minor Burns, Sunburn

Our board-certified dermatologists are capable of handling a wide range of skin conditions, from common issues like acne and eczema to more serious concerns like skin cancer.

Unlike AI-based dermatology apps, First Derm leverages the expertise of board-certified dermatologists to review your case. This means you're not relying on an algorithm but a real expert with years of training and experience in dermatology.

First Derm - Online dermatologist is not a substitute for a doctor’s visit. We are committed to providing reliable medical information based on the information we receive.
